name: videolens-extension
description: Turn videos into useful written reports with private BYOK and optional managed Pro modes

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.package: npm run verify:browser-parity && npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:firefox:source
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/package-release.mjs chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package-release.mjs firefox
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist-firefox --firefox=/Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox
